verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents a programmatic account-opening flow: Person and Business Applications followed by an Account Application, with initial-deposit funding and integrated bank-approved KYC/KYB vendors. A free Developer Sandbox is provided for testing the API before go-live, along with a pre-launch checklist. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that accounts are FDIC-insured, confirmation that approval to active status is fully automated with no manual bank review, explicit sandbox parity for the account-application flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
